trial_title: Evaluation of Response of Dasatinib to Treat Mastocytosis
brief_summary:
This is a multicenter, open-label, single arm phase II non-randomized study of dasatinib in which subjects with systemic mastocytosis (SM) will be treated with a continuous regimen of dasatinib.

Upon completion of a treatment induction period, subjects will be treated with dasatinib at a dose of 100 mg per os (OS) once daily (QD).

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of severe mediator-related symptoms (flushing, tachycardia) but does not have documented B-findings, which are required for smoldering SM.

eligibility_table.criterion: Men and women, ages 18 and older.

Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) must be using an adequate method of contraception to avoid pregnancy throughout the study and for up to 4 weeks after the last dose of investigational product in such a manner that the risk of pregnancy is minimized. WOCBP must have a negative serum or urine pregnancy test (minimum sensitivity 25 IU/L or equivalent units of HCG) within 72 hours prior to the start of investigational product.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient had a negative serum or urine pregnancy test with a minimum sensitivity of 25 IU/L within 72 hours prior to the start of the investigational product?
